title: Smoky Portuguese Potato Bake
description: A vegetarian, meal-prep dish featuring Portuguese-style potato buns in a smoky, spicy bake.
instructions: In a large copper pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to release their juices, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Add the potato buns and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the copper pot to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the potato buns are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Note: This dish can be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen for later use.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
